content.value_statement: AI agents lose useful lessons when outcomes are not recorded. This skill shows how to capture experiences, learn patterns, and recommend better strategies.
actual_capabilities: Shows how to initialize ReasoningBank with AgentDB persistence.
Demonstrates recording task experiences with outcomes, metrics, and context.
Explains pattern learning, pattern matching, and strategy comparison workflows.
Covers meta-learning, transfer learning, and adaptive agent examples.
Shows querying stored patterns and tracking learning metrics.
limitations: This is documentation and does not include executable scripts or tests.
Projects must provide agentic-flow, AgentDB, and Node.js dependencies.
Recommendation quality depends on enough recorded experiences.
Learned patterns still need human review for quality and relevance.

use_cases.title: Improve Code Review Agents
use_cases.description: Record review outcomes so an agent can compare strategies and recommend better review approaches over time.

use_cases.title: Optimize Repeated Workflows
use_cases.description: Capture task context and outcomes to identify patterns across recurring automation workflows.

use_cases.title: Prototype Learning Systems
use_cases.description: Use the examples to design agents that learn from outcomes, transfer knowledge, and track improvement metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Start a ReasoningBank Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new adaptive agent project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to plan a basic ReasoningBank setup for my agent. Include the required dependencies, storage choice, and first experience records.

prompt_templates.title: Design Experience Records
prompt_templates.scenario: Define what data the agent should store after each task.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design ReasoningBank experience records for my workflow. Include task type, approach, outcome metrics, and useful context fields.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Agent Strategies
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate strategy selection for repeated tasks.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to compare strategies for my agent workflow. Recommend metrics, confidence thresholds, and how to choose the best strategy.

prompt_templates.title: Build Meta-Learning Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design a meta-learning workflow with ReasoningBank. Include transfer learning, pattern review, pruning, and performance measurement.

output_examples.input: Create a plan for a code review agent that learns from prior reviews.
output_examples.output: A structured implementation plan with dependency setup, experience fields, quality metrics, strategy comparison steps, and review checkpoints.

output_examples.input: Help my automation agent learn which deployment response works best.
output_examples.output: A learning workflow that records incidents, compares response strategies, matches patterns, and recommends future actions with confidence thresholds.

output_examples.input: Audit my ReasoningBank design for long-term quality.
output_examples.output: A checklist covering data volume, context quality, threshold choices, pattern review, storage growth, and metric tracking.

best_practices: Record successes and failures with consistent metrics.
Include rich context so pattern matching has useful signals.
Review learned patterns before relying on recommendations.
anti_patterns: Do not train only on successful outcomes.
Do not accept low-confidence patterns without review.
Do not let old experiences grow without pruning rules.

faq.question: What does this skill help me build?
faq.answer: It helps you design agents that record experiences, learn patterns, compare strategies, and improve repeated workflows.

faq.question: Does it include runnable code?
faq.answer: No. It provides TypeScript examples and implementation guidance, but your project must provide the runtime dependencies.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it require AgentDB?
faq.answer: AgentDB is recommended for persistence in the examples, especially when storing experiences and patterns over time.

faq.question: How much data is needed?
faq.answer: The guidance suggests at least 100 experiences per task type for stronger recommendations.

faq.question: Can it replace human review?
faq.answer: No. Learned patterns and strategy recommendations should be reviewed before they affect important workflows.
